translations.web: “ ‘Don’t turn to those who are mediums, nor to the wizards. Don’t seek them out, to be defiled by them. I am Yahweh your God.
translations.bsb: You must not turn to mediums or spiritists; do not seek them out, or you will be defiled by them. I am the LORD your God.
translations.kjv: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the LORD your God.
translations.asv: Turn ye not unto them that have familiar spirits, nor unto the wizards; seek them not out, to be defiled by them: I am Jehovah your God.
